name: accordion
title: Accordion 手风琴
description: 一组可展开的标题，每项展开后显示对应内容。

whenToUse: 把多段内容收成标题列表，如常见问题、设置分组
type=multiple 允许同时展开多项

whenNotToUse.case: 只有一个区域需要展开收起
并列视图切换且一次只看一个

accessibility: 标题是按钮，支持 aria-expanded 和键盘操作
不要把必须看到的信息或关键操作藏在折叠内容里
responsive: 窄屏下比 tabs 更适合较长的标题
内容展开后随页面滚动

files.content:
# Accordion 设计规范

- 用于可以按需展开的次要内容（常见问题、分组设置）；用户必须看到的内容不要折叠起来。只有一块可展开内容时用 Collapsible。
- `Accordion.Root` 必须设 `type="single"`（同时只展开一项）或 `type="multiple"`；每个 `Accordion.Item` 设唯一的 `value`。
- `Accordion.Trigger` 外层渲染为标题，用 `level` 属性设成与页面结构相符的标题级别（默认 3），不要再在 Trigger 里套 `<h3>`。
- 标题写成能看出内容的短句；展开动效、间距跟随组件样式和组件参数，不要用 `class` 改 `duration-*` 或内边距。

{#snippet render({ props, state })} {@const attributes = { ...props, [refKey]: setRef }}
{@render children?.()}
{/snippet}

{#snippet render({ props, state })} {@const attributes = { ...props, "data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed", [refKey]: setRef, }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import { AccordionHeader, AccordionTrigger } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/accordion";
	import { styleToString, type StyleProperties } from "svelte-toolbelt";
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import IconPlaceholder from "$lib/components/icon-placeholder/icon-placeholder.svelte";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import { getAccordionOrientation } from "./context.js";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		level = 3,
		disabled,
		style,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "style"> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		style?: StyleProperties | string | null;
		level?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
	} = $props();

	const orientation = getAccordionOrientation();
	const refKey = createAttachmentKey();
	function setRef(element: HTMLElement) {
		ref = element;
		return () => {
			ref = null;
		};
	}
</script>

<AccordionHeader
	class="flex"
	data-accordion-header=""
	data-heading-level={level}
	data-orientation={orientation()}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		<svelte:element this={`h${level}`} {...props} data-state={state.open ? "open" : "closed"}>
			{@render trigger()}
		</svelte:element>
	{/snippet}
</AccordionHeader>

{#snippet trigger()}
	<AccordionTrigger
		data-slot="accordion-trigger"
		data-accordion-trigger=""
		data-orientation={orientation()}
		disabled={disabled ?? undefined}
		class={cn(
			"focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-ring focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-ring **:data-[slot=accordion-trigger-icon]:text-muted-foreground rounded-lg py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] font-medium hover:text-foreground hover:no-underline transition-colors duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none **:data-[slot=accordion-trigger-icon]:ml-auto **:data-[slot=accordion-trigger-icon]:size-4 group/accordion-trigger relative flex flex-1 items-start justify-between border border-transparent transition-all outline-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 motion-reduce:transition-none",
			className
		)}
		style={style && typeof style === "object" ? styleToString(style) : style}
		{...restProps}
	>
		{#snippet render({ props, state })}
			{@const attributes = { ...props, [refKey]: setRef }}
			<button {...attributes} disabled={state.disabled} data-state={state.open ? "open" : "closed"}>
				{@render children?.()}
				{@render icons()}
			</button>
		{/snippet}
	</AccordionTrigger>
{/snippet}

{#snippet icons()}
	<IconPlaceholder
		lucide="ChevronDownIcon"
		tabler="IconChevronDown"
		data-slot="accordion-trigger-icon"
		hugeicons="ArrowDown01Icon"
		phosphor="CaretDownIcon"
		remixicon="RiArrowDownSLine"
		class="pointer-events-none shrink-0 group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:hidden"
	/>
	<IconPlaceholder
		lucide="ChevronUpIcon"
		tabler="IconChevronUp"
		data-slot="accordion-trigger-icon"
		hugeicons="ArrowUp01Icon"
		phosphor="CaretUpIcon"
		remixicon="RiArrowUpSLine"
		class="pointer-events-none hidden shrink-0 group-aria-expanded/accordion-trigger:inline"
	/>
{/snippet}

{#snippet render({ props })} {@const attributes = { ...props, [refKey]: setRef }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}
